coverage: All nine daily-life topics have at least one original-source measurable nationwide baseline, with limited verified state statistics. These statistics are neither ZIP-level nor causal effects of officials or donors.
scopeNotice: Postal lookup yields an approximate state. The app uses state metrics only where source coverage exists; otherwise labels the displayed statistic national. ZIP input never becomes a FEC, political identity or benefit eligibility query.

housing.title: Rent of primary residence CPI
housing.method: Seasonally adjusted monthly FRED/BLS index; year-over-year comparison compares September 2025 to September 2026, not household bill dollars.

groceries.title: Food at home CPI
groceries.method: Seasonally adjusted monthly FRED/BLS index; year-over-year comparison compares September 2025 to September 2026, not household bill dollars.

energy.title: Average U.S. retail electricity price, all customer sectors
energy.method: EIA 2024 all-sector price; residential electricity bills may differ substantially.

health.title: Medical care CPI
health.method: Seasonally adjusted monthly FRED/BLS index; year-over-year comparison compares September 2025 to September 2026, not household bill dollars.

work.title: U.S. unemployment rate
work.method: BLS national seasonally adjusted civilian unemployment percentage; not a personal job-loss probability.

schools.title: Average current public-school spending per pupil
schools.method: Census Annual Survey of School System Finances. Nominal FY2024 dollars, not inflation adjusted, not school-specific budget or student benefit.

transport.title: Transportation CPI
transport.method: Seasonally adjusted monthly FRED/BLS index; year-over-year comparison compares September 2025 to September 2026, not household bill dollars.

public-services.title: Federal government current expenditures
public-services.method: BEA/FRED national current spending, billions of dollars at seasonally adjusted annual rate; neither state/local service allocation nor individual taxes.

representation.title: State and DC official election-office links indexed
representation.method: 51 official election authority directories indexed; the repo does not have verified 2026 certified canvass totals and must not imply all statutes validated.

electricity_2024_all_sector_cents_per_kw.note: Not residential-specific; includes all retail sectors and cannot estimate a household's actual energy bill.

school_2024_current_spending_per_pupil.note: Census press release verifies only top five and bottom five state values here, not the rest. State values cannot identify a school district or measure quality.

housing.localUnknown: Rent CPI is national, not your ZIP's asking rent. Local housing cost estimates require a separately sourced ZCTA/county series.

groceries.localUnknown: Food-at-home CPI is national. Product-level basket prices, grocery competition and income vary within states.

energy.localUnknown: State electricity averages are across residential, commercial and industrial customers. The user's utility and bill are unknown.

health.localUnknown: Medical CPI is not a premium, copay, provider fee or household-specific out-of-pocket cost.

work.localUnknown: National unemployment is not an area's jobs count or an individual job forecast.

schools.localUnknown: Spending per pupil is not instructional quality, your child's district budget or individual benefit.

transport.localUnknown: Transportation CPI tracks national price changes, not a transit route, commute time, fare or fuel purchase.

public-services.localUnknown: National annualized federal expenditure is not state/local budget, local taxes or household program funding.

representation.localUnknown: Election office is a verified directory, not a current representative list, certified canvass or source-verified state voter-ID law.

sourceDatasets.purpose: State election authorities and certification status, not election outcomes.
Secondary 2026 in-person ID classification; statutes and exceptions not verified.
Two verified recipient-UEI federal contract action series, not donations-to-local-employment return.
Eight company/PAC legal identifiers, not documented political influence.

dataFreshness: Snapshots retain original measurement/reporting periods. Scheduled updates or dynamic providers may be added only with source validation and no fabricated local numbers.
